attribution: ReconRiver Synthetic Reconciliation Scenarios by heybadrinath, https://huggingface.co/datasets/heybadrinath/reconriver-synthetic-reconciliation
purpose: volume near the 10,000-record capacity (regenerate; not committed)

rules.R1_NON_USD: batch has a non-USD processor or bank row (ClearLedger v0 is USD-only)
rules.R2_INVALID_ROW: batch has a row with an invalid ID, amount, date, fee or net
rules.R3_REPEATED_SOURCE_ID: a source ID appears more than once; the label counts it twice, ClearLedger keeps one record per ID
rules.R4_NO_LABEL: batch has no settlement ground truth
rules.R5_OUTCOME_NOT_MODELED: ground-truth outcome has no ClearLedger equivalent (late settlement window, duplicate bank entry, currency mismatch)
rules.R6_LABEL_ARITHMETIC: the label difference does not equal bank credits minus processor net for the batch rows
rules.R7_LABEL_WITHOUT_ROWS: a settlement label names a batch that has no processor or bank rows (logged; nothing to import)
